subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate one word to substitute the given group of words.**

one who speaks for others
solution: The correct answer is 'spokesperson'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let's take a look at the **meaning **of the options: • spokesperson: a person who is chosen to speak officially for a group or organization (किसी समूह या संस्‍था का प्रवक्ता (उसकी ओर से बोलने वाला पुरुष या महिला). • orator: someone who is good at public speaking (कुशल सावर्जनिक वक्ता). • verbose: using or expressing in more words than are needed (आवश्यकता से अधिक शब्दों से युक्त; शब्दबहुल; शब्दाडंबरपूर्ण). • talkative: fond of or given to talking (बातूनी, वाचाल). • Thus, from above, we can conclude that the one word which can substitute the given phrase is 'spokesperson'. • Therefore, the correct answer is option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **Mistake Points__** • There can be confusion between **'orator'** and **'spokesperson'.** • An orator will essentially be a person who speaks eloquently and use articulation whereas a spokesperson need not be eloquent. b8:Tb7b, The correct answer is** 'ADBC'.**
